Before you register.

When and where is the class?+
The class is online. The date, time and joining details are confirmed on registration.
Is the free class the same as the workshop?+
No. The free class is an introduction. The one-day online workshop is a separate R990 offer where you build workflows with guidance.
Do I need to buy an AI subscription first?+
No purchase is needed to register for the free class. Confirm the tool requirements with us before buying a subscription for the workshop.
Can I watch a recording immediately?+
This registration is for a future session. A recording is not currently offered as an instant download. You can read our free guides now.
